content.subject: Month‑end close automation hypothesis
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
I saw @theshipmonk’s welcome post for you as CFO. I suspect it may lead to tighter month‑end close, but I could be wrong. We run a rule‑based engine that matches transactions across ERP and accounting systems without manual entry. Could we find 15 minutes next week to discuss? I appreciate your time.
Zamp
